runtime_identity.rationale: L3 certifies the durable Scientific Research Machine capability from frozen source, experiment, runtime and governance evidence. It does not claim current VPS process health, current positions, current event counts, current deployment checkout identity, or burn-in completion.

revocation_invariants: PAPER to Research datasets remain immutable, provenance-bound and deterministically identified; the same dataset identity must not resolve to different scientific facts.
Research replay remains deterministic for identical bounded inputs and does not depend on implicit live data.
Canonical diagnostics remain reproducible, population-bound and fail-closed for NOT_AVAILABLE or unresolved metrics.
Candidate creation remains distinct from promotion; promotion cannot modify the same active epoch and requires a future governed boundary.
Market, PAPER and Research domains remain semantically separated and provenance-visible; no canonical metric silently mixes their populations.
Research output must not feed strategy, config, risk, sizing or admission changes into the same active Research-observed epoch.
Governed active-experiment capture, replay, diagnosis and publication remain attributable, immutable and non-authoritative with respect to PAPER runtime.
The integrated Research stack retains identifiable source lineage; runtime/experiment evidence cannot be reassigned to unrelated source identities.
